name: Read me first
info:
Okta-protected LLM endpoint.

1. Fill in slug and projectid on the enabler-llm node from your own project - do not copy them from someone else's export.
2. public=false on the security config is the point. Do not publish this as an open endpoint.
3. The cloud URL exists only after PUBLICATION, not after deploy,
   and it is keyed by the deptapp ID, not by this app's name:
   POST https://<portal>/flows/cloud/<deptapp-id>/api/llm-enabler/v2
   Read it off the deployment panel; do not compose it.
4. Add the mandatory use case node (audit palette) before you request an audit.
5. The app node and its Okta auth node are here and wired to each
   other. Every aXet.flows app authenticates with Okta - house rule.
   Nothing confidential lives on the auth node; dbEngineType is
   required, and without it every request dies with HTTP 500
   'Credentials is not well configured on App node'.
